title: Eyeglass Prescription

origin.title: Eyeglass Prescription (example image on 'Eyeglass Prescription - Understand All the Parameters')
origin.clearance_note: An example prescription the publisher made to explain how a prescription reads, shown on https://www.perfect-eyeglasses-guide.com/eyeglass-prescription.html, which introduces it as 'an example to see how it should look'. The prescriber named is Dr. Szasz Arpad, the site's co-author, acting in that role. The patient name and age are treated as specimen values on a publisher's example. The site is marked 'All rights reserved' and grants no reuse licence. The source URL serves a WebP rendition. The file here is the same 700x527 image from the publisher's JPEG at /images/glasses-prescription.jpg, re-saved without metadata.

notes: Requested: the team's existing doc45 eyeglass prescription schema, used unchanged; no feature page or fields were named. Featured: the right eye's complete distance prescription (sphere, cylinder, axis) with the exam date and prescriber, so the overlay reads as one prescription. The patient name grounds cleanly but was not featured, in favour of impersonal values. The date is printed 13.01.2015 and extracted as 2015-01-13. Schema findings: the form has Distance and Near rows, and the schema has no near row, so the extraction put each eye's Near sphere into 'addition', which on a real prescription is the difference between the two (here +3.00), not the near sphere. The schema has no fields for PD (64/62) or age. Prism is absent from the form; the schema requires it, so OD prism came back as empty strings and OS prism as null with a nonconformant_output warning.
